notes.title: Official release starts on April 30!
notes.notes:
It was officially released on 2021-04-30.

Now that we've implemented most of the features we want to build, we'll finish the Early Access and release it officially on 2021-04-30!

Campaign
This campaign is also a tutorial.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/b74d550d3d6521e9c7ab9095e79868d7edb15c9b.jpg.

Normal Mode
This is the main part of the game. Enjoy the freedom of castle building.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/a3f4cf6c1621817e0bdcde7e7b902db022d5630e.jpg

Endless Mode
You can build a large castle with more resources. Enemies will only increase, so finish when you are satisfied.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/7f0dc6c5f9abed9d21847c0ba3e59523e881277b.jpg

Siege Mode
You can be the one to place the enemy and attack the castle walls.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/17ba450654f16aa57f9b8589b8f21d6d84b7c662.png

Ranking
Create a cool castle structure. It's fun to see other people's castles.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/5799d1411439102d4735002fc0079ec30c4dd35e.jpg.

Replay Mode
You can view how the castle has been built, or output it to a GIF file.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36100225/9f47dcffeda91e5fcf60e9f99d089f47eb0db8a9.gif

notes.title: Official version to be released in April 2021, price to be raised to $15
notes.notes:
The game will be released as an official version after finishing Early Access in April of 2021.
Also, due to the increased volume of the game, we will raise the price to $15 when we release the official version.

We will continue to accept bugs and requests even after the official release, so please let us know if you notice anything.
